measured, not chosen

Every colour role in the Light theme. Required is the floor it had to clear; measured is the worst ratio against any surface it can land on; worst case is that ratio again with every channel of both colours nudged by one bit.

A role is picked by measurement: the engine scans the ramp and takes the first step that clears its target against every surface, then publishes the worst figure rather than the flattering one. accent.hover is measured against the label it carries instead, because it is a ground that holds text — a distinction that cost a real contrast failure to learn.
